items.title: Returns to Syria from Turkey exceed 775,000 since Assad’s fall: minister
items.excerpt: A total of 775,389 Syrians have returned to Syria from Turkey since the fall of Bashar al-Assad in December 2024, bringing the total number of returns since 2016 to more than 1.5 million, Turkish Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi announced.
